sloka: शैब्यः श्येनकपोतीये स्वमाम्सं पक्षिते ददौ ।अलर्कश्चक्षुषी दत्वा जगाम गतिमुत्तमाम् ॥२-१२-४३॥
transliteration: śaibyaḥ śyenakapotīye svamāmsaṁ pakṣite dadau ।alarkaścakṣuṣī datvā jagāma gatimuttamām ॥2-12-43॥

translations.english: (King) Saibya gave his own flesh to the hawk in the conflict between the hawk and the pigeon. (King) Alarka gave his eyes (to a blind man) and attained the highest state.
